sn21.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno rājagahe viharanti veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe ekavihāre.
sn21.3:1.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahā moggallāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallā nena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn21.3:1.5: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca
sn21.3:2.1: vippasannāni kho te āvuso moggallāna indriyāni
sn21.3:2.2: parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto santena nūnāyasmā mahāmoggallāno ajja vihārena vihāsīti.
sn21.3:2.3: oḷārikena khvāhaṃ āvuso ajja vihārena vihāsiṃ
sn21.3:2.5: kena saddhiṃ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:2.6: bhagavatā kho me āvuso saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:2.7: dūre kho āvuso bhagavā etarahi sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme
sn21.3:2.8: kinnu kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkami
sn21.3:2.9: udāhu bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkamīti.
sn21.3:2.10: na khvāhaṃ āvuso bhagavantaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkamiṃ
sn21.3:2.12: apica me yāvatā bhagavā ettāvatā dibbacakkhuṃ visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātu
sn21.3:2.13: bhagavatopi yāvatāhaṃ ettāvatā dibbacakkhuṃ visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātūti.
sn21.3:2.14: yathākathaṃ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:3.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante āraddha viriyo hotīti.
sn21.3:3.4: evaṃ vutte maṃ āvuso bhagavāpi etadavoca
sn21.3:3.6: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre avasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yantaṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apā puṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti
sn21.3:3.8: evaṃ kho me āvuso bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:4.1: seyyathāpi āvuso himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya
sn21.3:4.2: evameva kho mayaṃ āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya
sn21.3:4.3: āyasmā hi mahāmoggallāno mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo ākaṅkha māno kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyāti.
sn21.3:5.1: seyyathāpi āvuso mahatiyā loṇaghaṭāya parittā loṇa sakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya
sn21.3:5.2: evameva kho mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya
sn21.3:5.3: āyasmā hi sārīputto bhagavatā anekapariyāyena thomito vaṇṇito pasattho
sn21.3:7.1: itiha te ubho mahānāgā aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanu modiṃsūti.
